title: Schools in Tornado Alley Without Storm Shelters

lines: An EF5 tornado struck Moore, Oklahoma, during the school day.
Two schools were destroyed, and seven children were killed at one of them.
Neither school had a storm shelter.
Children sheltered in hallways and bathrooms.
The tornado collapsed walls and roofs.
Only reinforced safe rooms resist a direct hit like that.
New schools and homes now need storm shelters.
